passages.title: A Morning of Action in the Community Garden
passages.text: Every Saturday morning, volunteers gather to work in the town community garden. As the warm sunlight appears, tasks begin promptly at eight o'clock. The team leaders provide organic seeds, garden tools, and cold drinking water for everyone. Friendly volunteers carry heavy wooden boxes and soil bags from the shed to the planting beds. Each gardening group includes both enthusiastic young students and experienced retired neighbors. While digging near the stone wall, one young boy stumbled and fell onto the soft grass, but he was not hurt. An elderly gardener quickly reached out to hold his hand and help him stand up with a smile. The boy did not lose his cheerful enthusiasm, laughing as he brushed dry dirt off his trousers. Everyone wanted to finish planting all tomato seeds before the midday heat became too intense. Around eleven, the volunteers gathered under a large wooden gazebo to receive fresh apples and iced herbal tea prepared by local bakers. Working together in the open air makes difficult physical labor feel enjoyable and satisfying. The community garden project has now become a beloved weekly tradition that brings friendly neighbors closer together. Many participants hold deep gratitude for the fresh vegetables they can take home to feed their families. Next week, new activities will begin as they build a greenhouse to protect delicate herbs during cold winter nights. Through shared effort and cheerful cooperation, neighbors discover that community strength can carry them through any seasonal challenges.

passages.title: A Day of Energetic Action Along the Riverbank
passages.titleVi: Một ngày hành động sôi nổi dọc bờ sông
passages.text: Early on Saturday morning, local residents assembled near the riverbank for an energetic community restoration day. Families arrived in high spirits, with enthusiastic children bringing homemade snacks, cold drinks, and small trowels to share with everyone. Eager volunteers picked up heavy spades to dig deep planting trenches in the dark, fertile soil along the water. Nearby, strong youth helpers assisted the team by pulling stubborn riverside brambles and pushing heavily loaded wheelbarrows up the damp earthen pathway. Experienced community elders reminded younger workers that rough handling could easily mar the delicate bark of young fruit saplings, so everyone handled the fragile trees with great care. Before placing each sapling into position, volunteers carried large pails to fill the circular irrigation basins with fresh river water. During a well-deserved midday break, exhausted gardeners sat together on comfortable wooden benches beneath a majestic weeping willow to rest. Friendly local bakers demonstrated how families can preserve excess orchard peaches in airtight glass jars to enjoy delicious fruit throughout the cold months. On the adjacent open lawn, spirited schoolchildren gathered to throw bright rubber balls toward marked wooden targets. A lively round of applause echoed through the park whenever a skilled young thrower managed to hit the center target cleanly. As late afternoon arrived, cool mountain breezes caused vibrant autumn leaves to gently fall across the newly cleared walking paths. To conclude the memorable gathering, town leaders lit glowing decorative lanterns around the pavilion, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Looking out over the revitalized riverbank, everyone felt a profound sense of pride in what their united community had accomplished.

passages.title: Restoring the Historic Community Center
passages.titleVi: Phục hồi trung tâm cộng đồng lịch sử
passages.text: When community members unite around a shared goal, their combined actions can breathe new life into forgotten landmarks. Early on Saturday morning, neighbors gathered to restore the town's oldest heritage clubhouse. For years, neglect threatened to destroy the historic wooden structure before concerned residents formed a rescue committee. As golden sunlight began to appear over the hilltops, volunteers stepped forward to enter the building through the grand front doors. Inside, dust covered the polished floorboards, but the sturdy timber frames remain remarkably strong. Teams quickly divided up the repair tasks: experienced carpenters volunteered to fix broken window frames and shut damaged attic louvers securely against wind. In the overgrown courtyard, young helpers worked together to pull thick thorny brambles away from the stone pathways. Whenever someone needed specialized tools to reach high rafters, friendly neighbors stepped in to lend ladders and safety ropes. Organizers decided to seek architectural advice from local historians to ensure every repaired element matched original blueprints. Older residents brought historic photographs showing how vibrant community festivals used to exist in this very hall decades ago. Seeing these memories reminded everyone that historic buildings belong to future generations just as much as past ones. By late afternoon, the restored hall was swept clean, filled with fresh flowers, and ready to host community workshops once again. Taking collective action to protect local landmarks proves that human dedication can overcome neglect and renew civic pride. As neighbors shared refreshments beneath the porch, they felt proud of what teamwork had accomplished. Together, they demonstrated that historic heritage will always endure when citizens actively care for their hometown.

passages.titleVi: Một ngày khám phá và tinh thần đồng đội tại khu bảo tồn rừng
passages.text: Every autumn weekend, curious youngsters gather at the municipal forest reserve for a nature discovery workshop. Enthusiastic mentors organize engaging outdoor activities, combining environmental education with energetic team-building games. Before beginning their trail exploration, instructors explain that the afternoon program will consist of three interactive stages. In the first challenge, children playfully pretend to be forest rangers tracking elusive woodland creatures across the shaded grove. The children realize that genuine observation requires patience rather than simple pretending, so they watch quietly among the tall ferns. When an unexpected swarm of harmless dragonflies buzzed past, the alert scout had to swiftly dodge to keep her balance on the mossy log. Later, the young explorers take time to wander along sunlit pathways, admiring how wildflowers carpet the forest floor. An experienced field guide demonstrated how to tap gently on hollow birch logs to listen for subterranean beetle vibrations. Near the ancient oak tree, students observed an industrious gray squirrel bury shiny acorns beneath the rich woodland soil to prepare for winter. As the afternoon breeze turned cool, dense morning shadows began to disappear under the brilliant golden glow of sunset. By engaging directly with the living outdoors, the young explorers discover how diverse creatures collaborate to maintain ecological balance. Shared laughter and mutual encouragement help shy children build lasting friendships while conquering outdoor obstacles together. Through hands-on environmental exploration, students learn that protecting natural habitats requires ongoing community dedication. As the happy group packed their backpacks to return home, they carried inspiring memories of fellowship and wilderness wonder.

sentencePairs.vi: Gần cây sồi cổ thụ, các học sinh quan sát một chú sóc xám cần cù chôn những quả sồi sáng bóng dưới lớp đất rừng màu mỡ để chuẩn bị cho mùa đông.

sentencePairs.en: As the afternoon breeze turned cool, dense morning shadows began to disappear under the brilliant golden glow of sunset.
sentencePairs.vi: Khi làn gió chiều trở nên mát lạnh, những bóng râm dày đặc ban sáng bắt đầu biến mất dưới ánh hoàng hôn vàng rực rỡ.

sentencePairs.en: By engaging directly with the living outdoors, the young explorers discover how diverse creatures collaborate to maintain ecological balance.
sentencePairs.vi: Bằng cách tiếp xúc trực tiếp với thế giới ngoài trời sống động, các nhà thám hiểm nhí khám phá cách các sinh vật đa dạng hợp tác để duy trì sự cân bằng sinh thái.

sentencePairs.en: Shared laughter and mutual encouragement help shy children build lasting friendships while conquering outdoor obstacles together.
sentencePairs.vi: Tiếng cười chia sẻ và sự khích lệ lẫn nhau giúp những đứa trẻ nhút nhát xây dựng tình bạn bền chặt trong khi cùng nhau vượt qua các chướng ngại vật ngoài trời.

sentencePairs.en: Through hands-on environmental exploration, students learn that protecting natural habitats requires ongoing community dedication.
sentencePairs.vi: Thông qua việc khám phá môi trường thực tế, học sinh học được rằng việc bảo vệ các môi trường sống tự nhiên đòi hỏi sự cống hiến không ngừng của cộng đồng.

sentencePairs.en: As the happy group packed their backpacks to return home, they carried inspiring memories of fellowship and wilderness wonder.
sentencePairs.vi: Khi nhóm bạn vui vẻ đóng gói ba lô để trở về nhà, họ mang theo những kỷ niệm đầy cảm hứng về tình bạn và sự kỳ diệu của chốn hoang dã.

pronunciationNotesVi: Từ 'combining' phát âm là /kəmˈbaɪ.nɪŋ/, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai với nguyên âm đôi /aɪ/.
Từ 'consist' có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai: /kənˈsɪst/, âm tiết đầu là âm schwa /kən/.
Từ 'dodge' phát âm là /dɑːdʒ/, nguyên âm là /ɑː/ dài mở rộng miệng và âm kết thúc là phụ âm /dʒ/ dứt khoát.
Từ 'wander' phát âm là /ˈwɑːn.dɚ/, trọng âm nhấn vào âm tiết thứ nhất với âm /ɑː/ (tránh nhầm với wonder /ˈwʌn.dɚ/).

comprehensionQuestions.question: What does the afternoon nature program at the municipal forest reserve consist of?
comprehensionQuestions.questionVi: Chương trình thiên nhiên buổi chiều tại khu bảo tồn rừng của thành phố bao gồm những gì?
options: Three interactive stages combining environmental education with team games
A continuous five-hour swimming test across a rushing river
A mandatory paper-and-pencil mathematics examination inside a classroom
A silent meditation workshop without any spoken words
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Bài đọc nêu rõ: 'instructors explain that the afternoon program will consist of three interactive stages' và 'combining environmental education with energetic team-building games'.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What did the scout do when a swarm of dragonflies buzzed past her on the trail?
comprehensionQuestions.questionVi: Cô bé hướng đạo sinh đã làm gì khi một đàn chuồn chuồn bất ngờ vo ve bay qua trên lối mòn?
options: Swiftly dodged to keep her balance on the mossy log
Caught all of them inside a plastic jar
Jumped into a deep mud puddle
Ran all the way back to the park entrance
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn viết: 'When an unexpected swarm of harmless dragonflies buzzed past, the alert scout had to swiftly dodge to keep her balance on the mossy log'.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What did students observe an industrious gray squirrel doing near the ancient oak tree?
comprehensionQuestions.questionVi: Các học sinh đã quan sát thấy một chú sóc xám cần cù làm gì gần cây sồi cổ thụ?
options: Burying shiny acorns beneath the rich woodland soil to prepare for winter
Eating sandwiches left behind by tourists
Sleeping inside a discarded cardboard box
Chasing pigeons across the open parking lot
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Trong bài viết: 'students observed an industrious gray squirrel bury shiny acorns beneath the rich woodland soil to prepare for winter'.
